audit.whatIsWrong: The page rated this TRICKY 7.5/10 while every prose field says 'This is your lane' and Jax wins at a 54.62% clip over 520 games. Level 2 was 'Skill' and Level 6 was 'Neeko' in both layers, contradicting whys[1] ('the lane flips') and whys[4] ('deletes her').
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Neeko / Jax / Jax / Jax / Jax / Jax / Jax. Only level 1 is hers, before Counter Strike exists. Neeko is a squishy pick-mage with no dash apart from Pop Blossom's leap and no sustain, so once Leap Strike (700 range) connects she has no peel.
audit.corrected: diff FAV, diffRating 5/10; phases[1]/win[1] Jax, phases[4]/win[4] Jax with rating raised; difficulty prose aligned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Neeko's spike. Pop Blossom is 120/105/90s and is a commit, not a lane-winning steroid; Jax's Grandmaster's Might is 110s and answers it directly.
audit.why: Her R has a preparation wind-up before the leap and knockup — hidden only while she is disguised. Against a Jax who holds the Armor/MR active, it is a telegraphed burst into resists.
audit.corrected: Level 6 phase why rewritten to state both ultimate cooldowns and who actually wins the exchange.

audit.whatIsWrong: Jax's ultimate written as 'Grandmaster at Arms' in whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid; correct name is Grandmaster's Might. Also wants.you[1] told the player to 'eat her Blooming Burst on the dodge', which reads as Counter Strike absorbing it.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges basic attacks only — the early field already says so correctly, so the page contradicted itself. Blooming Burst, Tangle-Barbs and Pop Blossom all land through the dodge; the value of E here is the stun recast, plus Tangle-Barbs being a line skillshot that must be sidestepped rather than dodged.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster's Might everywhere; wants.you[1] reworded so the dodge is not credited with blocking her spells.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tangle-Barbs is called matchup-defining with no cooldown given.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s at 1000 range. A whiffed root is a 12-second window in which a squishy mage has nothing that stops a Leap Strike.
audit.corrected: Number added in the Levels 4-5 phase and the difficulty line.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Neeko's Tangle-Barbs is down.
edits.after: Take W: Leap Strike into an Empowered landing hit is a burst trade her poke cannot match, and she has no escape.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Tangle-Barbs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Sidestep Tangle-Barbs and its 12s cooldown is your window — she has no sustain and nothing that peels a duelist once you leap on her.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Neeko's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might (110s) beats Pop Blossom (120s): its wind-up is visible unless she is disguised, so pop your resists and take the fight.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Tangle-Barbs and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. The lane is decided by sidestepping Tangle-Barbs (12s) and sticking to a mage with no escape.

edits.before: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7.5/10, Neeko carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 5/10, Neeko carry threat 7/10.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms' Armor/MR steroid blanks her Blooming Burst and Pop Blossom burst while your on-hit deletes her.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might's Armor/MR steroid blunts her Blooming Burst and Pop Blossom burst while your on-hit deletes her.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms: pop the Armor/MR active and it eats her Pop Blossom + Blooming Burst burst while your on-hit passive ramps and one-combos her.
edits.after: Grandmaster's Might (110s): pop the Armor/MR active and it eats her Pop Blossom + Blooming Burst burst while your on-hit passive ramps and one-combos her.

edits.before: Hold Counter Strike through her commit, eat her Blooming Burst on the dodge, then recast to stun and ramp your on-hit passive until she dies
edits.after: Hold Counter Strike for her step-up — her spells land through it, so the payoff is the stun recast that lets your on-hit passive ramp on her

edits.before: This is your lane. At 4-5 your combo is online and she simply can't peel a melee duelist off her once you Leap Strike in — bait or eat the E root, then run her down. At 6 Grandmaster at Arms is the dagger: pop the Armor/MR active and her Blooming Burst poke and even her Pop Blossom do almost nothing while your on-hit passive ramps and deletes her. Watch the Pop Blossom wind-up (it has a visible leap tell and it's AOE, so don't all-in stacked on her minions or next to a roaming friend), and don't waste your leap on her Shapesplitter clone — but in a clean 1v1 she has no answer to you.
edits.after: This is your lane. At 4-5 your combo is online and she can't peel a melee duelist off her once you Leap Strike in — bait or eat the E root, then run her down; Tangle-Barbs is 12s, so a whiff is a free window. At 6 Grandmaster's Might is the dagger: pop the Armor/MR active and her Blooming Burst poke and even her Pop Blossom do little while your on-hit passive ramps. Watch the Pop Blossom wind-up (a visible leap tell unless she is disguised, and it's AOE, so don't all-in stacked on minions), and don't waste your leap on her Shapesplitter clone.

notes: This page was rated TRICKY 7.5/10 while every prose field describes a lane Jax wins from level 2 onward at 54.62%; the rating, the Level 2 row and the Level 6 row all contradicted the body text. Also fixed 'Grandmaster at Arms' (three fields) and a line in wants.you[1] implying Counter Strike dodges Blooming Burst — it dodges basic attacks only, which the early field already stated correctly.
